references.text: Describes Aaron's death on Mount Hor, where he was gathered to his people, just as referenced in Deuteronomy 32:50
Moses is told to go up to the Abarim mountains and see the land, and that he will be gathered to his people just as Aaron died
Reports on Aaron's death on Mount Hor in the fortieth year after leaving Egypt
Mentions that Aaron died at Moserah and was buried there
The fulfillment of the prophecy: Moses goes up Mount Nebo and dies there in the land of Moab
The expression 'gathered to his people' is also used regarding Abraham's death
The same expression 'gathered to his people' is used regarding Isaac's death
Jacob was gathered to his people at his death, using the same expression as for Moses and Aaron
